predictions: Another really good week last week (19-4), and now I'm sitting above 75% right for the season (224-74 total record). That's my 5th week with either 19 or 20 correct picks in just 13 weeks. Not too shabby. And now I have a winning record with every team outside C division (and only two there have fooled me more often than not - Darty Sanchez and One Armed Bandits). Last week to get through before tourney time…

Match of the week: (A Div.) The Bullies @ Ring of Elements. This match has lived in this slot for many of the recent seasons. And the outcome is about the same a HUGE percentage of the time… a 1001 for the win/title. It's honestly amazing how often these talent behemoths tie. And of course, we will tie again. And it's Element's turn to win 1001.

Match #2: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Darty Minds. The B race has been an ebb and flow between seemingly clinched and wide open. And after all that, the only way this isn't a head-to-head for the B title is if Raging wins this and Show Me still outscores them by 7+ (meaning Show Me would need a minimum of 19 unless this match includes a shorthanded team). I expect serious excitement and tension in this one, and I think they're going to 1001 again. This time, Raging takes the W.

Match #3: (B Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Show Me Your Tips. Assuming Raging helps out (but not too much, see match #2 above), Show Me could be trying to race to a division title. They win, but only by 17-7.

Match #4: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Red-eye Rangers. Here is the Machine's chance to just win and take the division title. It won't be an easy one though, as the Rangers are in the top three themselves (and theoretically could overtake the Machine for 2nd if they could ring up a colossal 21 this week). I'll take the Machine in a close little 14-10.

Match #7: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Runs with Corks. Every three weeks, She Said rises up and drops a big win on somebody. But they did that just last week, so I'll stick with the Corkers, 14-10.
Match #8: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Liver Alliance. Alliance will need to win by at least 8 to take the #3 spot from Fringe. They certainly could, but I'm guessing they won't. I'll go Fringe, 13-11.

Matches #9 & #10: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Iceman's; Trips Are For Kids @ Double In, Uber Out. If Trips Are For Kids can pull the minor upset tonight, a win over Iceman's by Dart Attack could drop Iceman's into a bottom-two finish and a possible drop to C in the spring. In the end though, I don't see the upsets coming to fruition here. Dart Attack freezes out Iceman, 15-9; and Uber ekes one 13-11.

Match #11: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Death Throw. It would take a crazy big score to drop Death Throw into a bottom-two finish. But the fact that that is even possible after a 4-0 start is nuts. DT, 13-11.
Match #12: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ Neighborhood Dart Knights. Lots of drama? Nope. But maybe a preview of the tournament final? Sure. I had thought this race was the Knights'. Nope. Nein, 14-10.
